About AllShore Talent

AllShore Talent partners with growing organizations to build high-performing technology and consulting teams. We connect skilled professionals with meaningful, long-term engagements across web technologies, digital experience platforms, and enterprise software delivery — offering competitive compensation, flexible engagement models, and a collaborative, remote-friendly culture.

About The Role

The Data Architect provides hands-on data architecture and technical delivery expertise for Adobe Analytics to Customer Journey Analytics modernisation. The role assesses the customer’s current analytics and data-collection implementation, defines the Adobe Experience Platform and CJA target architecture, maps existing data and components to the new platform, and guides implementation, validation and transition.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery covering current data collection, data models, identities, integrations and platform configuration.

  • Document the current-state architecture and define a scalable target-state architecture based on Adobe Experience Platform.

  • Translate business and migration requirements into schemas, datasets, identity designs, data flows and integration specifications.

  • Map legacy implementation components and data structures to the target platform, identifying what should be migrated, redesigned or retired.

  • Work with technical consultants and customer engineering teams to implement the agreed architecture.

  • Define data quality, governance, privacy, security, retention, validation and reconciliation requirements.

  • Investigate source-to-target discrepancies and guide their resolution.

  • Produce clear architecture, design, mapping and implementation documentation, and identify dependencies, assumptions and risks early.

  • Support architecture governance and technical quality throughout implementation.

  • Understanding of AEP guardrails and licensing constraints, including recognising when a design is technically possible but not available under the customer’s licence.

  • lead workshops, present and recommend solutions, document designs and gain customer agreement.


Experience and skills

Essential

  • Strong experience with web data collection and digital analytics implementation.

  • Strong working knowledge of Adobe Analytics, including report suites, variables, events, processing rules and implementation design.

  • Practical experience with Adobe Data Collection, including Adobe Launch or Tags.

  • Practical experience designing or implementing Adobe Experience Platform Web SDK solutions.

  • Experience with Adobe Experience Platform Mobile SDK and mobile data-collection patterns.

  • Strong Adobe Experience Platform experience, including XDM schemas, datasets, datastreams, batch and streaming ingestion, identity namespaces, profile enablement, data governance and retention.

  • Experience defining the data foundation for Customer Journey Analytics, including connections, data views, reporting identity and stitching approaches.

  • Experience mapping an Adobe Analytics implementation to an AEP and CJA target architecture.

  • Ability to validate data across Adobe Analytics, AEP and CJA and investigate reporting differences.

  • Experience facilitating customer-facing technical discovery and design workshops.

  • GDPR and privacy/consent awareness

Highly desirable

  • Previous delivery of an Adobe Analytics-to-CJA migration or modernisation program.

  • Experience using the Adobe Analytics source connector for historical data while establishing Web SDK or Mobile SDK-based future-state collection.

  • Experience analyzing report suites, classifications, processing rules, marketing channels, segments, calculated metrics and workspaces.

  • Understanding of field-based and graph-based stitching.

  • Experience designing for online, offline or cross-channel datasets.

  • Experience defining reporting-parity, reconciliation and acceptance approaches.

  • Experience supporting Adobe Analytics retirement following successful CJA implementation and validation.

  • Working knowledge of JavaScript, SQL, JSON, REST APIs and data-query or validation tools.

Expected deliverables

  • Current-state Analytics and data-collection assessment.

  • Target-state AEP and CJA data architecture.

  • Source-to-target mappings and XDM schema and dataset designs.

  • Identity, profile, datastream and Edge Network design.

  • CJA connection, data-view and reporting-identity design.

  • Migration assumptions, dependencies, risks and customer-owned activities.

  • Validation, reconciliation and acceptance plan.

  • Technical implementation and operational handover documentation.

Engagement details section:

  • Contract role.

  • Starts soon; a two-week notice period is acceptable.

  • Lasts 1–3 years.

  • Remote anywhere in EMEA, preferably Central Europe.

  • Occasional business travel, with expenses covered.

Program context: two migration paths built on AEP (AA → CJA and Campaign Classic → AJO). Customers are mostly B2C, across the UK, France, Spain, Germany, Norway and Italy.

Languages: strong professional English is required. German, French or Italian is highly valued.
